name: Victoria Hossack
abstract_title: Ultraweak photon emissions from the brain reflect cognitive states: Validating photoencephalography with an auditory perception task
abstract: Quantum biosensing is a rapidly advancing field that can provide neuroscientists insights into neural communication that were never before possible. Photoencephalography is an emerging method that measures ultraweak photon emissions (UPEs) from the brain. UPEs, particles of light coupled to the formation of reactive oxygen species (ROS), are primarily generated by mitochondria and, to a lesser extent, structures of the cell membrane.
